profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Ex-Afterpay, Ex-Block), Building Gimme
profile.summary:
AI Tooling & Development: Claude Code, Agentic Workflows, agent skills development

Programming & Markup: Ruby, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript(es6), C#, C++

Libraries & Frameworks: Nx, Spring, Kafka, Express, Next.js, RoR, Vue.js, React, React-Native, jQuery, Bootstrap, ASP.NET, jest (unit testing)

Databases & Data stores: Postgres, SQL, AWS Keyspaces, Redis, DynamoDB, MongoDB

Crypto Development: Solidity, Web3, Truffle, Ganache

Others: gRPC, Protobuffs, ETL, AWS (EC2, S3, SQS), Docker, Amplitude, Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Optimizely, Adobe Experience Manager, Salesforce Demandware

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building agentic workflows into all facets of SDLC including agentic only pipelines, QA, and MCPs
- Building embedded finance applications and tools for Partners and SMBs - replacing our paid license for Modern Treasury and Increase
- Implemented a dynamic CSP (Content-Security-Policy) overriding mechanism for PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) compliance with report-to API endpoint to track CSP violations in production. This reporting flows through DataDog and allows for the violations to be queryable thus enabling us to build additional monitoring on top of
- Mentoring engineers through constructive feedback in a safe-to-fail environment, guiding rather than prescribing solutions
positions.insights: Skills: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) · SOC 2 · Mentoring · Systems Design

positions.title: Platform Engineer II
positions.description: - Built a data quality monitoring tool to verify data cleanliness and truthy-ness amongst canonical identities within the Square/Block and CashApp ecosystem. Built with Kotlin, Kafka and Apache Airflow.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: - Previously eDriving now acquired by Aceable Inc.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Lead front end development for Teen Drivers Ed product on FLVS (Florida Virtual School) that is built
using Vue.js, .Net and C#. Currently ~60,000-70,000 students per year use FLVS to this day
- Initiate conversion of landing pages to Google AMP (Accelerated Mobile Pages). This improvement resulted in an average first-paint of ~14 seconds being reduced to ~2.8 seconds.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Build PSD’s that are delivered from the design team to change out the daily content on CharlotteRusse.com with mobile-first in mind
- Collaborated with the Site Merchandising team to build an internal tool to automatically generate website navigation bar using HTML, SASS, and JavaScript
- Work with Web Producers to enforce ADA compliance across CharlotteRusse.com
- Implement features that are put through the QA process and released after each sprint
- Follow BEM standards for semantic CSS architecture

positions.title: Lead Mentor | Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Lead a team of mentors to guide students in 16 weeks how to use and understand the fundamentals of semantic HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, version control (Git), JSON, and AJAX through project-based learning. The curriculum that we teach also introduces how to use AngularJS.
- Create projects/web applications for students to replicate or reference.
- Teach students how to curate a resume that is suitable and ready for the job application process.
- Assist students in searching for entry level developer roles.
- Provide 1 on 1 tutoring to ensure students are up to date and can be held accountable for projects/freelance work.

positions.title: Contract Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Complete overhaul of website for Computer Science professor Jon Degallier
- Implementing HTML5/CSS standards
- Writing media queries so that it is fully responsive (Desktop to mobile)
- General website maintenance with file uploading and debugging
- Being used by Intro to computer science students at Ohlone College
